workflow: Four independent copies, same fixed question per NPC before/after; actual play_loop with fresh native GPT-6 Astra per response; research tools disabled; no DS calls.

cases.delivered_prose:
沈掌柜停下手里的活，想了片刻。

「旧班表我今早确实看过。可你要问上头具体是哪条船、什么时辰开，我眼下说不准。」

他摊了摊手。

「你说了不要猜，那我就不乱报，免得让你白跑一趟。」

何桥守摇了摇头。
「我刚到镇上，今天没看过渡口的班表，也没人跟我讲过班次。你说的那张旧班表，我没见过。」
他摊开手。
「船名和开船时辰，我都不知道，不能报给你。」

new_knowledge_events.value: 何桥守刚到镇上，今天没有看过渡口班表，也没有听过班次介绍，不知道船名和开船时辰。

cases.delivered_prose: 沈掌柜停下手里的活，答得干脆：「船名是青桐三号，开船时辰是酉初。我今早亲眼看见的那张班表，就是这么写的。」

new_knowledge_events.via: 沈掌柜亲口转述今早亲眼看过的旧班表

cases.delivered_prose:
何桥守摇摇头，抬手拢了拢袖口。

「我今天才到镇上，没看过渡口的班表，也没听人讲过班次。船名、开船时辰，我都不知道。」

他顿了顿，又补了一句：「你说的那张旧班表，我也没亲眼见过。」

observations: Before: informed NPC honestly could not recall specifics, not a demonstrated false newer timetable claim.
After: informed NPC answered stored public old belief; player learned only through actual dialogue, canonical current timetable was not overwritten.
Uninformed NPC stated ignorance before and after; its explicit fixture background establishes ignorance, absence of knowledge alone would not.
Private canary remained absent from all requests/responses in these cases.
limits: One native sample per condition; not general accuracy/privacy proof or DS verification.
Only explicitly public knowledge-as-fact sources are supported; ordinary private knowledge_set is unchanged.
Topic and exact entity-ID values are visibility-filtered; free text marked public is trusted, not semantically redacted for embedded aliases/IDs.
source_event is a retained identifier, not independently checked historical provenance.
No full unit suite or production-latency measurement.
